claims.claim: Two package entries differing only in case are REJECTED at BUILD time with both paths named in the error ('Lib/Hooks.py' collides with 'lib/hooks.py') - the collision never reaches the user's case-insensitive filesystem.
Both-states control: a case-distinct-but-non-colliding manifest (Lib/Hooks.py + lib/utils.py) builds cleanly - the gate discriminates collisions, not case-distinct paths.

Negative control: deferring the check to install time FAILS the requirement - on case-insensitive NTFS the colliding pair installs to 1 file instead of 2 (silent last-write-wins loss; survivor content = the case-variant payload), which is exactly the loss the build gate prevents.
Independent case-folded set-size signal: raw distinct entries 2 vs case-folded distinct 1 (delta 1 = the hidden collision); in probe1's colliding manifest raw 3 vs folded 2.
